newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks dip at close as selling accelerates.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks dip at close as selling accelerates.

text.p: Dhaka stocks plunged at the close on Sunday as investors stepped up attempts to escape from a falling market, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) lost 24.48 points or 2.44 percent at 977.78 on turnover of 33.1 million taka. Loosers led gainers by 106 to 17.

"We expected market sentiment to be up following encouraging comments from the new chief of the Securities and Exchange Commission. But it seems investors paid no heed to him," said one broker. Leasing stock IDLC lost 47 taka to 1,832 and Apex Foods shed 100 to 1,728. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
